brief:
Rifts are widening within Israel's right-wing political camp ahead of parliamentary elections, Shehab Wire reported. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces mounting pressure to unite his allies and prevent the splintering of votes as tensions escalate within his coalition. The fracturing threatens his ability to maintain a stable governing majority.

Israeli reports indicate Netanyahu confronts a deepening crisis in consolidating political support. The divisions within the right-wing bloc underscore the challenges he faces in holding together a fractious alliance ahead of the ballot. Internal disputes over policy and leadership positions have strained relationships among key political partners in recent weeks.
